llm_description: Computes monthly revenue and units per region for sales orders, used for monthly performance reviews.
This script calculates salary statistics per department, including headcount, average salary, salary dispersion, and average bonus, and writes the results to a CSV file.

This script cleans and standardizes warehouse inventory data, including normalizing text, removing duplicates, handling invalid quantities, imputing missing costs, and calculating stock values and age.

This script calculates sales commissions for representatives based on closed transactions, ranks them, and computes an accelerator bonus for the top performers. The results are then output for payroll and finance processing.

This script fits a logistic regression model to predict the probability of default for retail loans based on borrower characteristics. It cleans the data, standardizes continuous predictors, and outputs the model coefficients and odds ratios for governance review.
